notes.title: GRAL update 0.9.4 !
notes.content:
GRAL Update 0.9.4

Hi everybody! Three Souls Interactive has been working hard on this new update. Here's what has changed:

Deathmatch mode no longer exist
New Planet Cruge
New track Cruge One and Cruge Two are now avilable for testing
New Team from planet Cruge is coming soon
[b]New keys binding feature is now available[/b] in the controllers option pannel. You are now able to configure you controller as you wish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32763775/076547046444fb03fbb543a1ae77e372f46ad44c.jpg[/img]

All shaders have been revised, improved and optimized
Minor graphics changes in some tracks
The Depot track layout has been revised and changed in places. Pay attention to the curves!
Some Lobby mecchanics have changed.
In single player mode there are no changes.
In splitscreen and online multiplayer modes, commands have been added to switch teams, to Kick a player and move a player from a team to another.
In-game chat and spectator mode have also been added. (online multiplayer only)
New improvements to the physics system
A new "unlocks" menu has been added to the player profile menu which contains all the unlockable items by earning Gral Coins (G-Coins). Now you can check all your progress on one screen.
All car stats have been adjusted to balance the game.
Fixed powerups MultiStikyEMP. Now working making 2point damage and slow down enemy cars for 3 seconds by 20%
New VFX for MultiStikyEMP powerups

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32763775/c09f6dd11903cdf012b5258429359c7a4500ffd5.jpg[/img]

Online Multiplayer buttons are available but not actived (closed beta option only)
Fixed astral orientation of planets during lockdown periods

Known issues:
The problem remains that sometimes the car remains attached to the guard rails and you are unable to move away.
Tutorial Tips may be appear in a wrong position
Loading tips may still have old powerups description.
Team Tamark have no secondary weapon.
Some Powerups Icon are missing or wrong
Level Editor is present but no props placement tool is available at the moment.
Ice shader in Ice Planet tracks still have some issue

Don't forget to let us know what you think of this update and be fast and tough!

The GRAL Team

notes.title: GRAL patch 0.8.5
notes.content:
GRAL patch 0.8.5 released

Hi racres!
The new update is now live on steam!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32763775/577857b4812cd6a9967f7a1c945dc98b2bf0e40c.jpg[/img]

League 1 has been completely revised. Many new rewards have been added, challenges have been recalibrated, missing previews added.
The challenge has been revised and now we run alongside the ghost of our best time. This will allow you to improve yourself lap by lap and also record your best time to share it on the steam workshop.

We have decided to release this update with all cars and tracks unlocked so as to give you the chance to test everything until league 2 and 3 are completed.

The new team with Tier Platinum and Iridium cars is now available, while for the Tier Titanium car you will still have to be patient.

The Hotras team now has the option to choose the second weapon. These are blasts of wind that destabilize the car hit. Run to test this new weapon and tell us what you think about the discussion board!

We also worked a lot on the balance of the game and on the statistics of the various teams. At the moment the statistics displayed for the car are not representative of the actual values. We are working to update all the panels.

Finally we know that not all texts have been updated in all languages. We apologize for this, our translator no longer works with us and we are looking for a new collaborator to complete the work. If you feel like it, give us a honk!

Prepare the engines that League 2 is coming!

The GRAL Team

Follow us on our big social news coming next week!

notes.title: GRAL Patch 0.7.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]GRAL changes in patch 0.7.0[/b][/h1]

[b]GRAL IS EVOLVING[/b]

As you know, GRAL is evolving and changing a lot from its first release. New features have been added, bug fixes, radical changes in the physics system, performance improvements, support for steering wheels and much more to come. All of this involved a great test period to verify that everything worked correctly and that the game was still well balanced.
As always, your advice has helped us to better understand where we should act to give you a unique experience and always guarantee maximum enjoyment.
Continue to leave us your feedback and reviews of the game so you can make GRAL better with each update!

[b]IMPORTANT: INCOMING STYLE'S COLORS RESET![/b]

With this patch the color scheme saved for your Style will be reset as we have moved to a new, more advanced and accurate system. We apologize for making you lose your rescues but we are sure that you will create new captivating liveries to show off with your screenshots!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763775/4e3881dd814e2614a7fae9736ec15b1bca40a3e5.png[/img]

[b]BUGFIXING[/b]

    Fixed issue for menu very slow response.
    Fixed reset position when flying out on the right side of the ice tunnel.
    Fixed random weird positioning the car on start line.
    Fixed some LOD switching in Radio Station.
    Fixed reflection in Ice Pipe, Radio Station, Crystals Valley.
    Fixed collisions in Crystals Valley and Exchange port. (Thanks Jagged)
    Fixed issue for physics on the Phoenix car.
    Fixed missing translation for sharing botton in timeattack menu.
    Fixed Fenril and Sharp Arrow wrong style visualization during customization and in race.
    New starting system. Now you have the chance to make a quick start. Keep the engine speed at the right rpm and get a burning start! (WIP)
    Improved the settings panel. New video presets and greater custom control of settings.
    New FX. Now we have a spark effect if we collide with walls!
    New air control system and physics.
    New wrong way check and respawn.
    New drift system. More stable and controllable check it and leave a feedback!
    New UI pannel. It shows you your teammates position and health during the race.
    [b]Tutorial![/b] We implemented a message system that will help you understanding the mechanics of the game the first time you start it.

notes.title: GRAL pimp your car patch is out! V.0.6.0
notes.content:
GRAL Early Access Release v.0.6.0 is now live!

Thanks to your advice and recommendations we have solved several bugs and further improved GRAL.
This patch activates the GRAL [b]HANGAR[/b] where you can customize your vehicles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763775/3a90dca3f030bbb96bcd2fb750e7c4c452dd18f0.jpg[/img]

We will add new styles, new decals and new features from time to time to allow you to customize your cars more and more.
With this first patch you can choose between two liveries (styles) for vehicles of the Platinum and Iridium classes. Each style allows you to customize up to 3 colors that characterize the livery.
Once you have configured your style you can choose it in the select car menu before the race.
Remember that if you are playing in team mode, your whole team will compete with the style chosen by the Leader.
With the next patch we will also insert the styles for the cars of the Titanium class and we will make some improvements to the already present styles.

Several graphic improvements have been made and some performance problems related to some tracks have been solved.

Let us see how you painted your cars, take a screenshot (F12) and share it on Steam and on the GRAL Facebook page.

notes.title: GRAL patch v0.4.0 is now live!
notes.content:
An update to GRAL has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart GRAL. The major changes in patch v0.4.0 include:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763775/48557cc4efea61a1aa282156879abb8ded929b4d.jpg[/img]

Halloween theme!!!  

For Halloween all teams have a new primary weapon! A powerfull rocket pumpkin!!! :D
The Second one is the classic Plasma Gun.
Added the weapon selection!
Now you can chage input controller by simply hit a key or button on the controller you want to use.
More options in the graphics control panel to play with. (Draw distance, V-sync, bloom quality etc.)
Added the audio control panel in the option menu.
Loading screen now correctely report your best lap for the loading track.
Added vibration when you are drifting (light vibration), when you are respawning and when you jump out of the track!
Fixed the missile incoming alert. Increased the distance at which the alert is activated. In addition, a graphic element has been added to the UI that indicates the approach of missiles heat seeker. 
More stable FPS in Radio Station and Red Canyon.
Quick Fix value is changed from 50 to 100.
Energy Drainer is now more effective.
And many other fixes !

AND... A FANTASTIC NEW TRACK !  Try it now! Make your best lap and share it on facebook to challange your friends!

Be Fast! Be Tough!

notes.title: GRAL Early Access Release v.0.3.0 is now live!
notes.content:
GRAL Early Access Release v.0.3.0 is now live!

We're doing our best to fix as many issues as possible for the next patch.

Here is the full changelist for patch 0.3.0:

Gameplay:

[b] Performance [/b]: we have improved overall performance, better and more stable FPS (WIP)
[b]Drifting [/b]: The cars now have an improved friction model that is different for each Team.
[b]KnockOut Mode [/b]: There is a timer that counts down and every time it reaches zero, the racer in last explodes.
[b]Ghost car [/b]: now visible in Time Attack from the beginning or after your first lap if you have no time record on that track(will mimic your best lap, every lap)
Better [b]Heatseeker missile [/b] navigation (WIP)
[b]Heatseeker incoming warning [/b]: Now there is a warning message and a sound alarm that warns you when a missile is approaching. 
Fixed vehicle getting stuck sideways on some race barrier and on some obstacles(now gets pushed off)
Fixed front camera view (WIP)
Fixed wrong position of Player 3 and Player 4 in splitscreen mode.

Levels:

Added new race boundaries to Crystall Valley and Excange port. This prevents the cars from flying out of the level
Excange port: Improved flow, eliminated many obstacles.
Radio Station: Improved overall performance.
Red Canyon: fixed crashed bridge jump. Now its possible to successfully jump on the other side also with a all Platinum Car.
Red Canyon: fixed respawn points. Now you are always respawned ON the track and not UNDER the track :)
    
Visual:

New Loading screen now with track lenght, race time and race record info. (WIP only track lenght works)
Cinematic camera has improved, with better views and implementation. Now you can use "C" + F1 to F8 to switch between cinematic cameras (WIP).
 Wide Screen resolution now supported.
 Menu: Fixed the problem of selection in the menu and the graphic elements that were starting to be invisible and other strange things.
 HUD: Changed car energy indicator and map indicator.
 HUD: Added in-game notification message sistem. Now the Link Sinc Drive System notify you when: a player as been destroied, Powerups shared, Sharing Failed, Best Lap, Final Lap, Eliminated by Knokout and Incoming Missile (WIP work only with Heatseeker based missile)
UI: Fixed UI pixel difficulty
